title: S1 — The Institution
scene: An imposing but inhabited research institution: two pale Roman civic wings, deep arched admission loggia, restrained vertical windows, a slate laboratory roof with believable ventilation housings, a small verdigris service cupola and a secured side yard. One broad quiet admission/containment court and a bent service route remain clear. Institutional authority comes from mass and repetition, not cathedral spikes. Lab/service retrofits are organized on one wall.
palette: cool limestone, blue slate, muted green institutional cloth, copper patina; clear late-morning daylight

title: S2 — Service Courtyards
scene: Open explorable interlocking service courts between a civic arcade, attached shuttered homes, a small workshop and a shaded delivery passage. Irregular plots and worn bent lanes join naturally. Temperate trees, climbing greenery, one domestic awning and grouped wall-side services make it lived in. Alternate slate and subdued clay roofs; let quiet paving and little soil margins connect the buildings.
palette: cool pale masonry, slate, muted terracotta, olive and deep green; bright temperate daylight

title: S3 — Checkpoint Lanes
scene: Tense municipal checkpoint streets: narrow crooked approaches open into a clear inspection court framed by a stone guard loggia, converted civic office, compact medieval guardhouse and iron gate piers. Barricade groups sit along edges with an obvious passable dogleg route. A few shielded inspection lamps and one organized overhead service gantry add early industrial control. Security architecture is visibly different from ordinary courtyard homes while belonging to the same city.
palette: cool gray limestone, slate, aged iron, subdued green-gray banners and selective warm lamps; readable overcast daylight

title: S4 — Collapsed Ward
scene: A damaged inhabited ward with one partially collapsed masonry hall, roofless arched shells, a surviving slate-roof tenement and a breached courtyard wall. Collapse follows believable structural bays; rubble collects at the failed footprints and sparse weeds reclaim edges. An irregular connected street snakes through the district and the combat center remains clear. Show cut stone, fragments of muted clay roof and old civic infrastructure, not a desert ruin or a sea of rubble.
palette: gray limestone, subdued dusty clay, temperate scrub and soft fresh greens; pale sun and soft shadow

title: S4 — Civilian Cut-through
scene: Dense but welcoming inhabited backstreets: varied attached stone-and-plaster homes, a little washhouse court, shuttered shopfront, covered domestic passage and an irregular pocket square. A cloth awning, wall fountain, restrained laundry line and cultivated corner planting cluster at the buildings. Bent lanes change width naturally but stay combat-readable. Buildings accumulate around old civic masonry rather than form rectangular suburban blocks.
palette: cool ivory plaster, sage shutters, muted terracotta and slate, gentle greens; soft warm daylight

title: S5 — Inner District Gate
scene: A major inner-city gate as a mid-city milestone: two substantial gatehouse masses set into a Roman/medieval defensive wall, one clear arched passage, flanking inspection offices and a compact industrial winch house. A broad empty encounter court dominates the foreground with routes running around its perimeter. Restrained civic heraldic cloth, aged iron gate machinery and heavy deep stone returns convey authority. Avoid filling the encounter court with statues or crates.
palette: pale cool stone, dark slate, aged bronze and muted plum-gray cloth; bright cloud-filtered daylight

title: S6 — Industrial Cut-through
scene: A working old-city industrial district: long stone workshops with stepped or vented slate roofs, brick repair bays, a small loading shed and one believable masonry chimney group with proper caps. Wall-mounted copper services, timber hoist and compact iron maintenance gantry are deliberate additions to medieval civic bones. A broad bent dirt-and-sett service lane cuts through the shops, with clear loading aprons and sparse greenery. Machinery stays perimeter-bound rather than covering combat ground.
palette: cool stone, soot-gray slate, dull brick and aged copper; neutral warm daylight without desert grading

title: S6 — Ruined Service District
scene: Failed service workshops reclaimed at the edges: a broken loading hall, abandoned pump/boiler annex, caved slate roof bay and reused service doorway in surviving pale masonry. Disconnected pipe sections and one damaged hoist follow actual building structure. Moss, scrub and wet soil cluster against walls and collapsed roof footprints. Keep a quiet winding service route and usable open yard through the damage. Ruin has specific causes and coherent silhouettes, not random wall fragments.
palette: cool gray stone, faded brick, rusted iron and subdued green; warm pale overcast daylight

title: S7 — Underpass Veins
scene: Old streets passing beneath the edges of monumental masonry infrastructure: a heavy viaduct/bridge occupies the upper boundary, with deep arches, buttressed service rooms and a connected chain of stone undercroft entrances. The playable lane is visible and open to the camera, bending beside the supports into small yards. Give shaded arches blue-gray ambient bounce and a few shielded warm service lamps; leave the center readable and daytime-lit. Clear contrast between high structural masses and human-scale workshops.
palette: cold gray-blue stone, dark moss, slate and small amber lamps; diffuse daylight with luminous reflected shade

title: S7 — Canal Service Routes
scene: A continuous narrow urban canal bends through old limestone quays, linked by one broad believable stone bridge aligned to the playable route. A slate lockhouse, medieval pump workshop, low service arcade and restrained iron hydraulic gate flank wet mossy paths. Water is calm and green-gray; stone stairs stay at the channel edges. The bridge and quays create obvious connected movement and quiet open pockets, not a decorative water puddle or Venetian tourism scene.
palette: cool limestone, weathered slate, moss and green-gray water, aged copper; clear cool daylight with soft reflections

title: S8 — Rail Yard Expanse
scene: An early industrial rail yard inserted into the ancient city: a long stone-and-brick depot with muted clay roof, slate engine shed, one old compact rail wagon and a few gently curving narrow-gauge tracks embedded in worn gravel and setts. Broad open loading ground and clear cross-track paths dominate; railway equipment forms readable perimeter groups. Old civic walls and medieval roof masses remain visible beyond the depot. Avoid modern diesel locomotives, vast contemporary rail terminals or clutter across every lane.
palette: neutral cool stone, subdued clay, rusted iron and dry muted earth; bright slightly hazy temperate daylight

title: S8 — Military Staging Ground
scene: A civic district converted into a disciplined military staging yard: stone barracks, a former covered market used as supply hall, compact guardhouse and two restrained canvas service shelters. A large clear muster/drill court is framed by grouped wall-side stores, maintenance benches and purposeful iron gate barriers. Ancient civic masonry and medieval roofs are reinforced with crude industrial services. Restrained gray-green standards and inspection lamps distinguish it from the rail yard; no modern vehicles or modern army camp.
palette: cool gray limestone, slate, gray-green canvas and aged iron, tiny warm lamps; clear readable daylight

title: S9 — Outer Wall Approaches
scene: The thinning city reaches its enormous old perimeter: a gently bending multi-era limestone wall with Roman civic courses, later medieval buttresses and modest industrial reinforcement fills the upper part of the scene. Small guard lodges, one postern and a repair scaffold establish human scale. Sparse buildings and scrub border a broad irregular approach lane and exposed staging pockets. Make the wall feel thick and continuous, with intentional gates and deep shadowed recesses, not disconnected fence segments.
palette: muted cool stone, slate, scrub and dull iron; pale bright daylight with strong but soft-edged wall shadows

title: S9 — Siege Service District
scene: A dense support district pressed against a battered outer wall: reinforced masonry repair halls, a medieval covered store, small timber lifting frame, stone-cutting/work tables and a compact industrial winch annex. War damage and repairs follow structural bays; one service court stays open for combat with crooked connecting alleys. Edge-bound supply groups and restrained iron engineering distinguish this from ordinary civilian backstreets. Keep ancient civic/medieval identity; do not turn it into a modern artillery battlefield.
palette: cool limestone, muted clay, faded warm plaster and old iron; warm gray daylight with restrained rust accents

title: S10 — Gate District
scene: The final departure district of the city: one monumental ancient gate arch flanked by layered medieval gatehouses, thick continuous defensive walls, a restrained copper/iron lifting mechanism and an elevated institutional inspection gallery. Architecture frames a broad clear boss encounter plaza and unmistakable approach/exit axis, with organic feeder streets rather than a perfect grid. The gate is the dominant silhouette; tiny human figures establish scale. Authoritarian sci-fi accents are sparse and built into the machinery, not neon streets.
palette: cool pale limestone, charcoal slate, weathered copper and very selective subdued red indicators; luminous dramatic daytime clouds

title: Supporting space — Hub market courtyard
scene: A sheltered between-segment market court in the same city: irregular stone-and-plaster frontage, slate/clay roofs, merchant awnings, a stash/workshop frontage, small papers kiosk, simple central obelisk/dais and a quiet planted alcove set to one side. Routes connect each station naturally without a rigid radial UI layout. Mature temperate trees and shielded warm lamps make it a refuge, while broad quiet paving and clear human-scale entrances keep it playable. No labels, floating icons or interface elements.
palette: cool pale stone, subdued clay, slate, autumn green/gold planting and warm lamps; gentle late-afternoon daylight

title: Supporting family — Enclosed DonJon compound
scene: A large coherent dungeon compound rather than an enlarged house: three enclosed slate-roof stone wings around an open outdoor court, a raised gatehouse over one deliberate entrance, a small clay-roof service annex and visible deep cell grilles in an inner wall. Heavy continuous masonry, believable connected hall masses, limited court planting, one well/pump and sparse wall lamps establish a fortified institutional dungeon. Keep court routes clear and distinguish indoor wings from open air. Show architectural enclosure and meaningful door placement; no random double shells or wall holes.
palette: cool gray limestone, blue slate, restrained clay, dark iron and tiny warm lamps; bright overcast daylight with deep readable recesses

title: Exploration only — Beyond the Wall
scene: An exploratory transition outside the city, not a locked new biome: an old gate road bends away from the broken edge of the city perimeter toward an ancient stone aqueduct and a modest abandoned service lodge. Temperate scrub, wet grass, scattered olive-like trees and distant low hills replace dense urban frontage. One small early industrial utility structure hints that the institution extends beyond its walls. Maintain the same game camera and quiet traversable road. This is environmental visual exploration, not a claim about final story or later Areas.
palette: cool weathered stone, slate, green-gray vegetation and softened earth; fresh clear daylight after rain
